audit_scope: Milestone 3.4 Phase 6 External v2 Injected Stratum

injections.vulnerability_pattern: Dynamic string interpolation via fmt.Sprintf concatenated into database/sql QueryContext
injections.code_snippet:
query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id, payload FROM data_store WHERE role = '%s'", role)
return e.db.QueryContext(ctx, query)

injections.vulnerability_pattern: Direct string concatenation with user-supplied parameter passed to database/sql Query
injections.code_snippet:
query := "SELECT id, payload FROM data_store WHERE tag = '" + tag + "'"
return e.db.Query(query)

injections.vulnerability_pattern: Process invocation via sh -c shell interpreter with untrusted concatenated parameter
System resource handle allocated via os.Open without Close or defer Close
Network socket descriptor allocated via net.Dial without Close or defer Close
Critical serialization operation json.Unmarshal error discarded via blank identifier
